name: Workplace injuries and fatal work injuries by state and industry (BLS SOII and CFOI)
description: How often workers are hurt on the job in each state and industry, and how many die: the nonfatal injury and illness rate per 100 full-time workers for private-industry sectors and detailed industries in 42 states and DC (Survey of Occupational Injuries and Illnesses, 2024), and the number and rate of fatal work injuries in every state and DC, with the major cause and the industry rate (Census of Fatal Occupational Injuries, 2024). Every record carries its BLS series or table. Survey estimates carry a relative standard error and a noise flag, and every figure is the one BLS publishes. It is statistics about industries and states, never about a named employer.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Workplace injuries and fatal work injuries by state and industry (BLS SOII and CFOI) (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23898154

distribution.name: work-injuries.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: work-injuries.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: work-injuries-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in work-injuries-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to work-injuries.csv on id.

recordSet.name: work-injuries
recordSet.description: The records of Workplace injuries and fatal work injuries by state and industry (BLS SOII and CFOI), one per CSV row.

field.name: state
field.description: US or a two-letter state code (DC included)

field.name: kind
field.description: soii-industry (nonfatal rate), cfoi-total (fatal injuries in the state), cfoi-industry (fatal rate in an industry) or cfoi-event (fatal injuries by cause)

field.name: level
field.description: all, supersector, sector (2-digit NAICS), subsector (3-digit NAICS) or event

field.name: naics
field.description: NAICS code (2 or 3 digits), a range such as 31-33, or ALL

field.name: industry
field.description: Industry name, as BLS words it

field.name: value
field.description: The headline number of the record (see unit)

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
